products.name: Options on Bitcoin Futures
products.underlying: Nearest-expiring eligible standard Bitcoin futures; monthly options use same named delivery month.
products.exercise: European; automatic exercise; contrary instructions prohibited
products.settlement: Delivers one futures contract at strike; monthly futures immediately cash-settle to BRR. Weekly delivery leaves futures exposure.
products.available_expiry_days: Monday-Friday; monthly replaces corresponding Friday weekly
products.monthly_termination: With underlying futures, normally last Friday of month at16:00 London
products.weekly_fixing: Notionally adjusted transaction VWAP of BOTH standard Bitcoin and Micro Bitcoin futures during15:30:00-15:59:59 London
products.monthly_fixing: Underlying final settlement: CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate published16:00 London; observation window15:00-16:00 London

products.name: Options on Micro Bitcoin Futures
products.exercise: European; automatic exercise; contrary instructions prohibited
products.settlement: Delivers one Micro Bitcoin future; monthly delivered future immediately cash-settles to BRR
products.available_expiry_days: Monday-Friday; monthly replaces corresponding Friday weekly
products.monthly_termination: With underlying futures, normally last Friday of month at16:00 London
products.weekly_fixing: Notionally adjusted combined Bitcoin and Micro Bitcoin transaction VWAP15:30:00-15:59:59 London
products.monthly_fixing: BRR final settlement, published16:00 London; observation15:00-16:00

products.name: Options on Bitcoin Friday Futures
products.exercise: European; automatic exercise; contrary instructions prohibited
products.settlement: Financial; ITM call cash equals fixing minus strike multiplied by0.02
products.listing_schedule: Daily Monday-Friday expirations for two consecutive weeks
products.last_business_day_of_week_fixing: Underlying BFF final settlement: BRRNY published16:00 New York, observation15:00-16:00
products.holiday_rule: Expiry remains if business day in either London or US; joint holiday shifts to preceding eligible day
